violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies (26 TAC §744.501(18))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not provided the corrections to the Operational Policy that are required: parent rights, procedures for inclusive care, employee vaccinations, emergency preparedness, procedures for parents to participate and immunization requirements.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not provided the corrections to the Operational Policy that are required: parent rights, procedures for inclusive care, employee vaccinations, emergency preparedness, procedures for parents to participate and immunization requirements.

The operational policy did not have a section for the following: parent rights, procedures for inclusive care, employee vaccinations, emergency preparedness, procedures for parents to participate and immunization requirements.
Procedures for parents to review and discuss with the director any questions or concern about policies and procedures needs to be added to policies.
